about: Routing cases: one request per skill that should use it, and one nearby request that should go to the named sibling, or to no skill (expect null) because none of them does that job. Prompts for 32 skills come from docs/CREATOR-PROBES.md, the carousel, ScriptCraft and off-topic probes from docs/QUALITY-EVALS.md, with placeholders filled in by invented details. Labels are the maintainers' judgement; open an issue if you disagree with one. Hard cases are worded so that a router reading only skill names would likely pick `trap`; they measure whether the descriptions do their job.
